features: 【High Performance Android 15 Tablet】The 10 inch tablet is equipped with the latest Android 15 system, with a powerful quad-core processor, a storage capacity of 64GB ROM + 12GB RAM (4GB physical RAM + 8GB extended virtual RAM) and 1.8GHz CPU, providing you with a smooth and fast Internet experience. You can also expand the memory to 1TB to store more apps, pictures, e-books, music or videos.

【10.1 inch HD Screen Tablet】 The resolution of the tablet is 1280 x 800 IPS, this 10.1 inch tablet features an ultra-slim bezel design and a sensitive high-definition multi-point touch screen. Equipped with 8MP + 2MP front and rear dual cameras and dual speakers, the large screen design and more detailed and bright color expression bring you a higher level of audio-visual enjoyment.

【2-in-1 Tablet with Keyboard】 The Android 15 portable tablet recently released in 2025 has a 2-in-1 working mode and comes with a keyboard, wireless mouse, stylus and foldable protective case. You can enter text directly with a stylus, or you can type comfortably using the keyboard, in two ways, one-touch convenience, easy response to various scenarios, making your work and study get twice the results with half the effort.

Long Battery Life The android 15 tablets are powered by a 6000mAh continuous upgrade large battery, which can support 360 hours and continuous use up to 6-8 hours, easily charged through the 5V/2A Type-C port.Super power and long battery life, say goodbye to the problem of insufficient power.

【Stay Well Connected All the Time】2 in 1 tablet support dual-band WiFi, the tablet can easily connect with 5G/2.4G WiFi. You don't have to worry about not being able to connect to wifi in public or at home, it is better for more scenarios, and the powerful reception signal keeps you well connected at all times.
